UI_trait_KH_PluviophileDesc:
You feel calmer when it rains.
Stress and unhappiness slowly decrease while rain falls.
The effect doubles when you're outside in the storm.
UI_trait_KH_PluviophobeDesc:
Rain makes you anxious.
Stress and unhappiness slowly increase while rain falls.
The effect doubles when you're outside in the storm.
UI_trait_KH_ComicNerdDesc: You get double the boredom and unhappiness relief from reading comic books.
UI_trait_KH_TherapyAnimalsDesc:
Animals nearby calm you.
Stress, unhappiness, and boredom slowly decrease toward 50% while any animal is within 5 tiles.
The effect does not stack across multiple animals.
UI_trait_KH_ForageFeastDesc:
You're more likely to find fresh fruits, vegetables, and edible flora when foraging.
Eating those raw makes you happier.
UI_trait_KH_NeatFreakDesc:
You feel strongly about cleanliness.
Filthy rooms and dirty bodies hit you harder, but clean surroundings and good hygiene give you a comfort boost.
Mutually exclusive with Slob.
UI_trait_KH_SlobDesc:
You don't really notice grime.
Filthy rooms and personal dirtiness barely affect your mood, and tidiness doesn't reward you.
Mutually exclusive with Neat Freak.
UI_trait_KH_ToughBladderDesc:
Years of long shifts.
Your toilet need rises noticeably slower, and you can hold it longer before accidents.
UI_trait_KH_WeakBladderDesc:
You go when you need to go.
Your toilet need rises faster, and the accident threshold is lower.
UI_trait_KH_OutdoorsyDesc:
Comfortable in the woods.
No mood penalty for relieving yourself outdoors, and your bath need rises slightly slower.
UI_trait_KH_CaffeineDependentDesc:
Your body runs on coffee.
Going more than 36 hours without coffee or tea brings on a withdrawal headache: extra stress and unhappiness until you get a cup in you.
Easy to manage with reserves.
UI_trait_KH_ColdHandsDesc:
Your fingers stiffen in the cold.
Crafting, tailoring, cooking, and electrical work all take 25% longer when the ambient temperature drops below 5°C / 40°F.
Indoor work in a heated room is fine.
UI_trait_KH_TinnitusDesc:
Persistent ringing from old hearing damage.
Gunshots and explosions aggravate the ringing for an hour after: extra stress and a small unhappiness spike.
Doesn't affect quiet survival.
UI_trait_KH_EasilyStartledDesc:
Sudden loud noises rattle you.
Thunder cracks, gunshots, and explosions trigger a brief panic spike and a small endurance hit.
Bites in active combat or thunderstorms; never in calm moments.
UI_trait_KH_SentimentalDesc:
You attach to keepsakes.
The first photo and the first business card you pick up become mementos. If a memento is destroyed or lost, you feel it for hours afterward.
Easy to manage — just don't lose them.
UI_trait_KH_HighMaintenanceDesc:
Your standards don't drop just because the world ended.
While at your claimed homestead, a bare or empty space lowers your mood; one you've decorated to your liking restores it.
Place at least 15 of your own items in your homestead to keep the mood positive.
No effect outside your homestead — you know it's not your problem out there.
UI_trait_KH_LonerDesc:
Other people set you on edge.
Stress slowly rises when other players are within range, and stacks per additional player.
Solo play: dormant.
Mutually exclusive with Needs Attention.
UI_trait_KH_NeedsAttentionDesc:
Being alone wears on you.
Stress rises when no other players are within range; relief when at least one is.
Bites constantly in solo play; manage in multiplayer by sticking with someone.
Mutually exclusive with Loner.
UI_trait_KH_HatesAnimalsDesc:
Animals make you uncomfortable.
While any animal is within 5 tiles, your stress and unhappiness creep up.
One animal is enough — multiple don't stack worse.
Mutually exclusive with Therapy Animals.
UI_trait_KH_VegetarianDesc:
You don't eat meat or animal products.
You CAN if you have to, but it makes you unhappy: -15 happiness per portion of meat, fish, eggs, dairy, or similar.
Plant-based eating is fine.
Mutually exclusive with Vegan.
UI_trait_KH_VeganDesc:
You refuse to consume animal products.
The eat action is blocked entirely for meat, fish, eggs, dairy, and similar items.
You'll need a steady supply of plant-based food to survive.
Mutually exclusive with Vegetarian.
